name: @ism/ui-native
description: ISM Design System for React Native (dot.Bible app): theme, typography, icons and components for iOS and Android.

scripts.build: npm run build:index && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('fonts',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('../web/assets/fonts-static'))fs.copyFileSync('../web/assets/fonts-static/'+f,'fonts/'+f)" && tsup
scripts.test: npm run build:index && node --import ./test/register.mjs --import tsx --test test/*.test.tsx
